title: “Pink”
text: “Pink”. As excited I was to have these, they were not pink on the walls. It wasn’t the quality of product, it was that when they lit up, they looked a muted white. I’d bought to replace white snowflakes & these hearts looked like softer color rocks. I would’ve tried the bigger red ones, but was feeling let down.

product_metadata.title: St Patrick's Day Shamrock Fairy String Lights - 13.8ft 40 LED Green Battery Operated Fairy Lights with Timer, Remote and 8 Lighting Modes, Lucky Clover Lights for Indoor St Patrick Day Decor
features: 🍀 【 Shamrock String Lights for St Patrick’s Day Decor 】- The battery-operated fairy lights are 13.8 feet long with 40 mini shamrock-shaped LED. The thin copper wiring and smaller-sized LED bulbs add a delicate and romantic touch to your indoor/outdoor space

🍀 【 Battery Operated Shamrock Lights with Remote 】- Elegant mini four-leaf clover design, up to 32 feet handy remote control, 8 amazing working modes, 6H on 18H off timer available for this waterproof string lights. 3 AA batteries (batteries not included) could last approximately 30 hours, remote capable (included in the package)

🍀 【 Green String Lights with Timer 】- The timer keep the lights on for 6 hours at a time, then automatically shut them off for 18 hours, sparing yourself remembering to turn it on and off each evening while saving the power at the same time

🍀 【 Waterproof and Portable 】 Both the lights and the battery case are waterproof, you can easily carry and place the cute green lights string anywhere you like. You can use the remote or the battery case to turn the lights on and off, change the modes, cycle through your favorite mode and enjoy the romantic atmosphere

🍀 【 Wide Uses for Indoor and Outdoor 】- Perfect decoration and unique gift for St Patrick's Day, Christmas, birthday, home wedding, parties and other celebration occasions. It can be easily draped across the bed headboard, hang on small trees, photo walls, windows, doors, dolls, pianos, etc.
